An animal's '''multiply_value''' affects the [[item value|value]] of animal products such as meat, raw hides, silk thread, and anything made from these raw materials, including leather or silk clothing. While it's possible for multiply_value to apply to only specific parts of a creature, all non-modded creatures use SELECT_MATERIAL:ALL, so all parts of the animal are multiplied.
